blocks.text: Deceive allows you to configure and deploy decoys to disrupt active attacks, create fake attack paths, and gain high-fidelity threat intelligence. You can deploy decoys across public-facing endpoints, network, cloud, and Active Directory (AD) to detect threats. For a complete list of ranges and limits per Deceive feature, see Ranges & Limitations.
The Deceive feature provides the following benefits and enables you to:

blocks.item: Configure Internal and Zero Trust Network, Threat Intelligence (TI), AD, cloud, and landmine decoys.
Create deception strategies based on your business and organizational requirements.
Create a blocklist based on IP addresses and ports and configure hostname resolution of attackers' identities.

blocks.text: The key features of Deceive are:

blocks.item: Stop lateral movement: Network decoys deployed in the network detect attackers attempting to move laterally and disrupt them.
Disrupt ransomware: Decoys placed across your environment detect and slow down ransomware at every stage of the kill chain and limit its blast radius.
Detect compromised users: Decoy passwords, cookies, sessions, and bookmarks to decoy applications detect compromised users when an attacker uses one of these deceptive assets.
Detect prebreach threats: TI decoys detect prebreach threats that specifically target your organization.
Detect enumeration activity and malicious access: Decoy users in an AD detect enumeration activity and malicious access.

blocks.text: The Deceive Summary page (Deceive > Summary) displays the details of all the decoys that are deployed in the Zscaler Deception Admin Portal.
On the Summary page, you can do the following:

blocks.item: View the summary of all the decoys that are created and deployed in the Deception Admin Portal.
View the decoy deployment status percentage.
View the deployment health status of the Decoy Connectors and service back ends.
View and analyze deployment logs to troubleshoot deployment issues.
